def _line_candidates(x, y):
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    distinct = x[i] != x[j]
    i, j = (i[distinct], j[distinct])
    slopes = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
    errors = np.abs(y[i, None] + slopes[:, None] * (x - x[i, None]) - y)
    return errors
